snippet.title: CrisisX Official Trailer | Gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Check the official gameplay trailer for the CrisisX - Your Last Survival!

Step into a post-apocalyptic world, prepared to be captivated by the mysterious landscape, unlimited exploration, dangerous zombie hordes and  fierce competition for resources with other survivors! 

Gamescom: 08/20/2025 - 08/24/2025 
BOOTH: HALL 9.1 B059 in Cologne, Germany

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512880?utm_source=Youtube
